# DubForge 1.6.2 - unlimited roles
DubForge no longer stops at eight speakers. Add as many tracks as your scene has roles, and DisDubs will cast them all.

- **No track limit.** DubForge has 24 track colours, and they repeat after that. With many speakers the lanes get flatter so the timeline stays manageable.
- **Reopening keeps every speaker.** Packs with more than eight speakers used to come back with tracks nine and up merged into track eight. That's fixed.
- **The DisDubs check matches DisDubs again.** Past ten speakers, a scene counts as a cast when each name has about four clips on average. Names that differ only in capitalisation count as one role, just as DisDubs treats them.

Already on DubForge? Accept the update banner when it appears, and DubForge updates itself and restarts. New here? Download **`DubForge-DisDubs-Setup-1.6.2.exe`** below.
